alibabacloud-pai-dsw-manage v0.0.2 changelog

- Increased minimum Aliyun CLI version from 3.3.1 to 3.3.3.
- Updated installation instructions: Added mandatory plugin update step (`aliyun plugin update`).
- Enforced user-agent string: All CLI commands must now include `--user-agent AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-pai-dsw-manage`.
- Clarified installation and workspace listing procedures for greater accuracy and reliability.
- Improved documentation for parameter confirmation and version verification.

Initial release of alibabacloud-pai-dsw-manage.

- Manage the full lifecycle of Alibaba Cloud PAI DSW (Data Science Workshop) instances: create, update, start, stop, query, and list.
- Support querying available ECS compute specs by region and accelerator type.
- Detailed requirements and confirmation steps for all user-customizable parameters.
- Strict credential and permission validation guidance, with security best practices.
- Built-in instructions for handling RAM permissions and troubleshooting.
- Reference materials and command-line snippets provided for workspace and spec discovery.
